[spoiler=THE FOUNDING OF THE ERNHARDT SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONE]
[i]RELEASED JOINTLY BY THE ARELIAN OFFICE OF EXTERNAL AFFAIRS AND THE VALONIAN PRESS OFFICE.[/i]

THE ERNHARDT CHARTER

SECTION I - ESTABLISHES THE ERNHARDT SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONE AS A FREE ZONE AND INDEPENDENT ENTITY. CHARTING THE EXTENT OF THE ERNHARDT MOUNTAINS AS THE AREA OF THE ZONE, SIMILAR YET DIFFERENT TO THE FORMOSA SPECIAL ZONE OF THE FORMOSA BASIN.

THE ERNHARDT SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONE (HEREAFTER THE ZONE) IS AIMED TO INVITE INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION IN NATIONAL EXTRACTION OPERATIONS AND SHARES SHALL BE SPLIT 2:1. IN THIS, NATURAL AUTHORITIES (THAT OF THE RESPONSIBLE, RIGHTFUL JURISDICTION) MAY BRING CORPORATE ENTITIES INTO LINE.

SECTION II - THE SPECIAL ZONE SHALL BE ADMINISTERED BY ADMINISTRATORS, ON BEHALF OF A BOARD OF MEMBER STATES, WHO SHALL VOTE ON DECISIONS OF THE ZONE.

SECTION III - FURTHER ZONE MEMBERS MAY BE ADMITTED,
WITH CANDIDACY AND FULL MEMBERSHIP RELYING ON MEETING CONDITIONS OF:

[list][*] DEMOCRACY, AND
[*] THE RULE OF LAW.[/list]

WHEN ALL CONDITIONS ARE FINALLY MET, A VOTE OF THE FULL BOARD SHALL FINALISE ITS DECISION. THE CANDIDATE MAY APPEAL TO THE BOARD, BUT MUST WAIT TO REAPPLY.

SECTION IV - ESTABLISHES THAT RENT SHALL BE SET AT AN EQUITABLE ~ FOR THE ACCOMMODATION OF BUSINESS AND THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE ZONE, 
WITH THE RATES CHARGED EQUAL TO THE VALUE OF THE GOODS EXTRACTED AND THE RELIABLE SERVICES PROVIDED.
RENT MAY CHANGE THROUGH THE TRADE BOARD BUT RATES MUST GO THROUGH THE INTERNATIONAL FORUM.

SECTION V - POWER AND WATER SHALL BE PROVIDED BY AUTHORITIES, WITH PROVISIONS PROVIDED BY COMPANIES, STANDARDISED BY AUTHORITIES OF THE ZONE.

SECTION VI - ESTABLISHES THE ZONE SECURITY FORCE, CHARGED WITH THE SECURITY AND SAFETY OF THE ZONE AND ITS PERSONNEL. MEMBERS STATES SHALL MAKE CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE SECURITY FORCE AND A DISASTER FUND THROUGH SEPARATE CONTRIBUTIONS.

SECTION VII A - FOR SUMMARY CASES, PRE-TRIAL CRIMINALS SHALL BE RETURNED TO THEIR NATURAL JURISDICTION, WHERE THEY MAY FACE TRIAL.

SECTION VII B - FOR INDICTMENTS AND CIVIL DISPUTES ARISING FROM THE FREE TRADE ZONE, NATURAL JURISDICTIONS (NATIONAL) SHALL BE TURNED TO THE INTERNATIONAL COURT OF JUSTICE.

SECTION VIII - THE ONLY AUTHORISED EXTRACTION METHOD SHALL BE OF THAT IN SITU RECOVERY. EXTRACTORS MUST CONSIDER THE ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACTS OF AND DURING EXTRACTION, WITH LIMITS IMPOSED BY THE NATURAL JURISDICTION AND THE BOARD.

SECTION IX -  ESTABLISHES THAT IT IS THE DUTY OF THE EXTRACTOR TO REHABILIATE AND RECOVER THE ENVIRONMENT AND AREA. 
NO MATTER THE COST.

SECTION X - WITH ITS SIGNING, ITS SIGNATORIES SHALL BRING THE CHARTER INTO FORCE AND ALL PARTIES SHALL BE BROUGHT INTO LINE WITH IT. 

SIGNED

William Manor
[i]President of the Arelian Union[/i]

Christopher Calhoun
[i]President of the Valonian States[/i]

This is part of the military aid package that the president of Hydronia signed off on earlier this week to support a crucial ally. Along with these material forms of assistance, Hydronia has also sent medics to help soldiers near or at the front lines, and observers to help in the planning of military maneuvers and offensives.

In addition, several Hydronian destroyers have moved into position off the coast of Vespurias to support another ally in the event that the war spills over. A Hydronian aircraft carrier, carrying AWACS aircraft and several classes of fighter jets have joined the destroyers.

[i]"During these times,"[/i] said the Hydronian president during a press conference, [i]"we must ensure that the allies not in the war are protected from it, and that our allies in the war are supported to the best of our ability."[/i]
